faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can I see the invitation before paying?
faq.a1: Yes. You fully prepare the invitation and preview it on your phone. You pay only when you publish.
faq.q2: How do I see guests' replies?
faq.a2: Every reply appears in your dashboard instantly and the Telegram bot notifies you. You can export the list to Excel.
faq.q3: Can I change it after publishing?
faq.a3: Yes, without limits. The link stays the same and guests see the updated details.
faq.q4: How long does the link work?
faq.a4: For 90 more days after the celebration. The period can be extended if needed.
faq.q5: How does the Individual plan work?
faq.a5: You describe the template and your wishes, our designer contacts you on Telegram and customises the invitation.
faq.a6: With Payme or Click. Once the payment is confirmed, the invitation goes live within seconds.

gulli-darvoza.tagline: A golden gate, white roses and a video intro
gulli-darvoza.description: A golden gate covered in flowers opens onto the bride and groom. A video intro with sound, champagne gold colours and elegant lettering. The most festive choice for weddings and nikah.

lojuvard.tagline: Samarkand lapis and a graceful arch
lojuvard.description: Blue and white tones, an arch frame and handwritten-style names. A classic, calm invitation.

anor.tagline: Pomegranate red and a romantic frame
anor.description: Deep red and pink shades with corner ornaments. A warm, heartfelt mood.

zumrad-tun.description: A deep green background, gold lines and an arch. A dignified style for nikah and fotiha.

oq-atlas.description: White and grey tones with calm typography. A modern, simple invitation.

tungi-osmon.description: A deep navy background with bright names. For evening weddings and qiz bazm.

sahro.description: Beige and brown shades with an arch frame. A good fit for osh and khatna.

lola.tagline: Tulip pink and a soft mood
lola.description: Gentle pink colours and an elegant typeface. For fotiha and qiz bazm.

kumush.tagline: Silver and a clean modern style
kumush.description: Grey and black tones with crisp lines. A simple choice for any celebration.

samarqand-peshtoq.tagline: A blue-tiled portal and opening doors
samarqand-peshtoq.description: The blue-tiled portal of a Samarkand madrasa, pomegranate trees and a golden sunset. The doors open onto a candlelit courtyard with the bride and groom. A video intro with sound, islimi ornaments and turquoise accents.
